services.name: Port St. Joe Forgotten Coast Wildlife Adventure
services.desc: The Forgotten Coast is an area about an hour east of Panama City Beach that stretches from Mexico Beach to Apalachicola. This area consists of very small sleepy beach towns and secluded waterways that are rich in marine wildlife. St. Joseph Bay is an Aquatic Preserve has some of the healthiest sea grasses in the state of Florida. 80% of the marine wildlife in Florida depends on these grasses for survival. This makes this area magical for snorkeling. On our tours in Mexico Beach and Port St. Joe we will usually find a pod of Dolphins in their natural habitat completely undisturbed by human Private Tours Departing From Port St. Joe, FL

services.name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise in Panama City Beach
services.desc: Enjoy the beautiful sunset, music, wildlife, and dolphins! 1.5 Hours About On this tour, we find and watch the dolphins play and feed while also watching the sunset if your tour is around sunset time. We also tour some of Shell Island and St. Andrews state park and show you some of the local wildlife. We may also be able to get off the boat on some of these pristine beaches and explore if we have time. Enjoy some beautiful moonlight and music on the way back to the dock. An iced cooler with water is included. You are welcome to bring any of your own snacks and drinks. BYOB is 1.5 Hours • Private Charters Available
